state_machine.name: IDLE
state_machine.description: Fresh invocation point. Output is forced to zero until parsing proves a valid IPv4 string in this invocation.
transitions: IDLE -> SEG_START on invocation start; reset parse accumulators and set valid := false
IDLE -> INVALID if visible string length is zero or NUL is not found within STRING capacity

state_machine.name: SEG_START
state_machine.description: Beginning of a decimal segment. The segment must be nonempty.
transitions: SEG_START -> INVALID on '.', NUL, whitespace, sign, or any nondigit

state_machine.name: SEG_DIGITS
state_machine.description: Accumulate decimal digits for the current octet; leading zeros are allowed. Any accumulated value >255 is invalid.
transitions: SEG_DIGITS -> SEG_DIGITS on ASCII digit if currentValue <=255
SEG_DIGITS -> INVALID on ASCII digit if currentValue >255
SEG_DIGITS -> AFTER_PERIOD on '.' when digitSeen, currentValue <=255, and segmentCount < 3
SEG_DIGITS -> COMPLETE on NUL when digitSeen, currentValue <=255, and segmentCount = 3
SEG_DIGITS -> INVALID on NUL before four segments, extra period, empty segment, or nondigit

state_machine.name: AFTER_PERIOD
state_machine.description: A period has completed a segment; the next character must begin the next nonempty segment.
transitions: AFTER_PERIOD -> INVALID on '.', NUL, whitespace, sign, or nondigit

state_machine.name: COMPLETE
state_machine.description: Exactly four nonempty decimal segments have been parsed, each 0..255. Pack octets in network byte order.
transitions: COMPLETE -> DONE after computing ((oct0*256 + oct1)*256 + oct2)*256 + oct3

state_machine.name: INVALID
state_machine.description: Malformed text, nondigit segment, wrong segment count, capacity issue, or out-of-range segment. Pending output is zero.

state_machine.name: DONE
state_machine.description: End of the current invocation. No parse state is retained for the next scan; the next invocation restarts at IDLE.

timer_plan.reset_conditions: No timers. Parsing is combinational within one invocation and has no timed state.
timer_plan.notes: No TON, TOF, or TP function blocks are used. Stage 3 contains no timer calls.

priorities: Safety first: check STRING capacity and visible NUL-terminated text before truncation; reject any nondigit, sign, whitespace, hexadecimal, embedded nondigit, empty segment, wrong segment count, or segment value >255.
Any invalid condition forces ipValue := 0 in the same invocation. A previous nonzero ipValue must never be preserved.
Valid input packs octets in network byte order: first segment is the most significant byte and fourth segment is the least significant byte.
Leading zeros are allowed within STRING capacity. The valid address 0.0.0.0 and all invalid inputs both produce ipValue = 0.
Parsing is deterministic and stateless with respect to inputs: identical ipText across invocations produces identical ipValue.
Validate all data before writing the final output; the unified output stage is the only writer of ipValue.

scan_execution_order.name: edge sampling
actions: Sample ipText once at invocation into a local current-text buffer.
Determine visible length up to the first NUL and verify it is within STRING(254) capacity before truncating.
Optional previous-text copy may be maintained only for diagnostics; no output decision may depend on previous scan state.

scan_execution_order.name: safety/reset priority and state transitions
actions: Reset parse accumulators: visibleLen, charIndex, segmentCount, currentValue, digitSeen, valid, octets, pendingValue.
Run the state machine: capacity/NUL check, four nonempty decimal-digit segments, each 0..255, exact segment count, and no invalid characters.
Safety priority: on any violation set valid := false and pendingValue := 0 immediately.
On valid input, finalize four octets and compute pendingValue := first*16777216 + second*65536 + third*256 + fourth.

scan_execution_order.name: unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
actions: No timer function blocks are required or called.
This stage is intentionally empty; no timer can affect parsing or output.

scan_execution_order.name: unified output assignments
actions: Single assignment point: ipValue := pendingValue when valid is true; otherwise ipValue := 0.
Because pendingValue is already zeroed for invalid input, ipValue := pendingValue is also safe, but the safety form is explicit.
